title: Super happy with our subscription!
text: We loved the variety and the quality of tea we received each month. We drink A LOT of tea of all varieties and were incredibly picky about the quality and flavor of our teas. All the teas we have received have been fantastic. The tea is just the right amount for all thee of us in our household because we steep the tea 2-3 times before we toss it, absolutely no problems with the flavor diminishing when we adjust the steep time depending on which pot number we are brewing. The only thing we would change is to have the ability to re-order our favorite flavors after we have tried them.
label: positive
